verses.text: Ix schek winhaj rey Nabucodonosor b'ochaj jun yechel ayoch oro t'ay, 30 metro ste'el, haxo sat, oxe' metro. Ix yalan winh to tz'ak'jiem t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Dura t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.

Ayik toxo ix b'oel jun yechel chi', ix yawtankot heb' winh ayoch yajalil winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en, haton heb' winh yajalil soldado, heb' winh gobernador, heb' winh ak'um razón t'a yoltak chonhab', heb' winh molum tumin, heb' winh juez yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil. Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a juntzanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' t'a yichanh jun yechel chi', yik tz'och sk'inh yuj heb' winh.
Ha jun mach ayoch t'a yib'anh sloloni, te cha'anh ix aj yalani: Ab'ek he masanil ex anima ix ex kot t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a junjun nación yet' t'a junjun ti'al.

Ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, haton flauta, tanhb'il, arpa, salterio, zamponia yet' masanil juntzanhxo son, ol ex em kumnaj he masanil t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel ix schek b'ojok winhaj rey Nabucodonosor tik.
Masanil mach manh ol em kumnaj ejmelal t'a jun yechel tik, elanhchamel ol yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al, xchi.
Yuj chi', masanil anima ayek' molan chi', ayik ix yab'an heb' sk'e nhilnaj son chi', ix em kumnaj heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ha t'a yik chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Caldea ix ul ak'an queja heb' winh aj Judá t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' opisio t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha ach ix ala' to ayik sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, tz'em kumnaj masanil anima ejmelal t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel tik,
haxo mach max k'anab'ajani, syumchajb'at t'a yol horno sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al, xa chi.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Judá, haton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego, heb' winh ix ak'och yopisio t'a yol smakb'en Babilonia tik, maj sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix ala'. Max och heb' winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh a diosal, max empax kuman heb' winh t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ochajk'e tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix schekan winh ik'chajkot heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom yel a ex tik Sadrac, Mesac yet' Abed-nego maj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh in diosal yet' t'a yechel in diosal ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik?

Ha tiknaik jun, tato b'ekan he k'o'ol, ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj son chi' junelxo, ol ex och ejmelal t'a yichanh jun yechel ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik, malaj tas ol ex ik'anok. Tato max he k'anab'ajej eyem kuman ejmelal jun, a wal t'a jun rato chi', ol ex yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al. Tato icha chi' ol ex utajok, ¿machto junok Dios ol yal ex skolanel t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj tas wach' kalan yuj jun tik.
Ha ko Diosal b'aj tzonh och ejmelal a onh tik, syal onh skolanel t'a skal k'ak' t'a horno chi'. A' ol onh kolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Wach'chom manh ol onh koljok yuj jun, palta mamin rey skak' ojtakejeli to manh ol onh em kuman t'a juntzanh a diosal chi' yet' t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ojok tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh slolonel heb' winh kelemtak winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix chakb'i wal sat winh skot yowal. Ix schekan ekchajk'e sk'ak'al jun horno chi' winh, masanto jantak stechaj schakb'i sik'lab'il.
Ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh soldado winh te ay yip, yik stzek'chaj heb' winh oxwanh chi', syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.
Ha heb' winh oxwanh chi' ayto och spichul heb' winh sk'an t'a yopisio b'aj ayochi, ix tzek'chaj heb' winh yik syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.

Snib'ej winh rey chi' to elanhchamel syumjiem heb' winh t'a yol horno chi', yuj chi' ayik ix yumjiem heb' winh yuj heb' winh soldado chi', ix k'eul kopnaj te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh soldado chi', ix cham heb' winh yujto te ow sk'ak'al.
Haxo pax heb' winh oxwanh chi', tzek'b'il heb' winh ix emk'och heb' winh t'a yol horno chi'.

T'a elanhchamel ix k'e juknaj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix xiwk'e winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yajal ayek' ta': --¿Tom manh oxwanhoknhej heb' winh kelemtak tzek'b'il ix yumjikanem t'a skal k'ak' chi'? xchi winh. --Ichaton chi' mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

--Palta chanhwanh heb' winh swila', tijanel heb' winh, sb'eyek' heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' chi', malaj wal jab'ok tas tz'ik'an heb' winh. Haxo jun schanhil chi', lajan wal yilji icha junok Dios, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil sti' horno chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Sadrac, Mesac yet' ach Abed-nego, schekab' ex Dios Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, elanhekkoti, tzex kot t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix elta heb' winh yoxwanhil t'a kal k'ak' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och umnaj masanil heb' winh yajal t'a yol jun nación chi' yet' heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yil heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi', malaj wal jab'ok sniwanil heb' winh ix tz'a yuj k'ak' chi'. Ix chamwal yilan heb' winh to malaj jab'ok xil sjolom heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj pax jab'ok spichul heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj wal jab'ok sjab' te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego to a ix chekankot yángel yik skoljiel heb' schekab' syak' wal och sk'o'ol t'ay. Maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il a in rey in tik heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ol heb' winh scham t'a yichanhpax yem kuman t'a yalnhej tas diosal to manh sDiosalok heb' winh.

Ha tiknaik a in swala' to yalnhej mach anima sb'uchwaj t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego tik, chok' tz'aj heb' schami. Haxo spat heb' sjuchajem smasanil, wach'chom tas chonhab'il, tas nacional, ma tas ti'al syala', yujto malaj junokxo Dios syal skolwaj icha sDiosal heb' winh tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi' winh rey t'a niwak opisio t'a smakb'en Babilonia chi'.
